title: SceneDocument
description:
A persistent scene source. IDs are authored ASCII names, never runtime IDs.

Loading sets no count budget (decision 029); bulk pixels and geometry
belong in files beside the scene (version 7). Prefabs share scene-wide
assets across their placements.
Unknown fields are rejected to expose authoring mistakes. Arrays retain
authored order when serialized, yielding stable, readable source diffs.

animations.description:
Keyframed clips that entity `animation` players play (decision 035).
Version 8.

environment.description:
The scene's atmosphere and rendering effects (decision 022). Requires
version 5. With it the scene owns the whole look: instantiation sets
every section, omitted ones to the engine defaults. Without it the
game's own settings stay.

prefabs.description: Reusable local entity trees. Definitions share this document's assets.

skins.description: Joint lists that deform skinned meshes (decision 036). Version 8.

streamed.description:
Entities that exist only near the camera (decision 086): each root
with its descendants is one item, which world streaming spawns when
its cell comes within range and despawns when it leaves. Parents,
animation targets and skin joints stay within an item; IDs differ
from `entities`'. No terrains. Requires version 9.

textures.description: Opaque sRGB pixels: inline base64, or image files (version 7).

AtmospherePreset.description: A starting point for an atmosphere; fields set beside it override it.

Biome.description:
A biome: where it applies (`fitness`, everywhere when omitted) and the
layers of its ground. Later biomes paint over earlier ones where they
fit; the first covers wherever none of the others do.

BiomeLayer.description:
One layer of a biome's ground: `material` (an ID of the surface's
materials) painted over the layers before it where `mask` allows, at
most `opacity`. A biome's first layer covers its whole ground.

Blend.description:
How a layer's heights combine with the heights of the layers before it,
weighted by the layer's coverage: added, the higher or lower of the two,
or replacing them.

Cover.description:
The cover growing where a surface material lies (decision 056): blades
per square meter where the material lies alone, the shortest and
tallest blades and their width at the root (meters), the linear color
of their tips (roots take the ground's), and how far they lean in the
wind (0 stiff, 1 the most).

Deformer.description:
Presses tracks into deformable ground (decision 083) as a scene version
9 `deformer` field: each fixed tick, while its entity's world position
lies at most `contact` meters above the terrain under it (or below it),
it presses a footprint `radius` meters across, from where it pressed the
tick before, sinking ground as deformable as that `depth` meters along
its middle (deeper by however far it lies below the ground), round
(`flatness` 0, deepest along its middle like a wheel's rut) to flat (1,
a foot's or a plate's level floor). Put it where an object meets the
ground: a wheel's or a foot's lowest point. Radius 0.01 to 50, depth
and contact 0 to 10, flatness 0 to 1.

ErosionLayer.description: A layer that erodes the layers below it (decision 068).

creep.description: Square meters of hillslope creep each round, 0 to 1000.

incision.description:
How fast rivers cut each round: the stream power law's erodibility
times its time step, 0 to 1.

level.description:
The pyramid level whose samples it erodes: finer levels wear finer
valleys and take longer, 0 to 15.

rounds.description: Rounds of incision and creep, 1 to 400.

FarPlacement.description:
Where a placement layer also stands far away (decision 061): on the
tiles of `level`, coarser than its own, a `share` (0 to 1] of its
objects, the candidates ranked first, where its own level's tiles are
not resident.

Grounded.description:
Stands its entity on the terrain (decision 086): its translation's y is
kept `offset` meters above the ground under its x and z. Unparented
entities only; without a resident tile under it (or over a hole) the
entity keeps its translation, as walking navigation agents keep theirs:
their walks stand them, on bridges' decks too (decision 111). Requires
version 9.

HydrologyLayer.description:
A layer that bakes where water runs over the layers below it and carves
channels into them (decision 066).

channel_area.description: Square meters of upstream area where channels begin, 100 to 1e10.

depth.description:
Meters deep and wide channels are where they begin; downstream their
depth grows with the fourth root and their width with the square
root of the area they drain, up to `max_depth` and `max_width`.

level.description:
The pyramid level whose samples the bake reads: finer levels carve
narrower channels and take longer, 0 to 15.

stream_area.description:
Square meters of upstream area where streams begin (decision 097):
channels draining less than `channel_area` run as streams down to
the rivers they join, their width falling with the area they drain
below a river's at its head and their depth with its square root,
cut a little into the ground. 0, the default, has none, as has
`channel_area` or more; at most 1e10.

Interior.description:
An interior's light (decision 079): the shares of the sky's light and of
the sun's that reach surfaces inside its probe's box, each 0 to 1,
blending in over the probe's blend distance inside its faces. Requires
version 9.

Mask.description:
A value from 0 to 1 at every sample, from the sample's height, slope,
curvature and position: where a biome applies, or where a material
covers its biome's ground. Ramps run from 0 at their first value to 1 at
their second, smoothly, falling when the first is the larger.

oneOf.description: The same value everywhere.
A ramp over meters above the terrain's origin.
A ramp over the ground's slope, in degrees from level, 0 to 90.

A ramp over the ground's curvature: how fast its slope grows per
meter, positive in hollows and valleys, negative on ridges.

A ramp over the base-10 logarithm of the area draining through the
ground, in square meters, as the terrain's hydrology bake found it
(decision 066): channels begin near its channel area. 0 without one.

A ramp over the bake's wetness index, ln(a / tan b): about 5 on
steep ground, 10 and more in hollows and along streams.
A ramp over how deep water would stand in a filled pit, in meters.

A ramp over meters from the nearest river's edge (decision 092),
negative in its water: `[2, 0]` covers river beds with two meters of
banks. Beyond every river's reach (sixteen meters past its edge),
and without rivers, it reads 1e9.

A ramp over meters from the nearest road's edge (decision 069),
negative on roads: `[1, 0]` covers roads with a meter of soft edge.
It averages the ramp across each sample's footprint, so roads
narrower than coarse levels' samples fade there instead of breaking
into dashes. Further than 32 meters beyond every road's shoulders,
and without roads, it reads 1e9.
Gradient noise from 0 to 1.
The product of masks.
The sum of masks.
The smallest of masks.
The largest of masks.
One minus a mask.
A mask remapped by a ramp: 0 up to `from`, 1 from `to`.

MeshSource.description: Supported geometry recipes, including arbitrary validated triangle meshes.

oneOf.description: Centered unit square in the XZ plane, facing +Y.
An engine mesh buffer file (`EMB1`) beside the scene. Version 7.

A virtual mesh file (`EVG1`, decision 044) beside the scene: a
cluster hierarchy renderers draw as the clusters each view needs, and
elsewhere as its most detailed cut of at most `fallback_triangles`
triangles (4096 when omitted). Built by `cargo xtask asset import`
for dense meshes. Version 8.

NavAgent.description:
Walks its entity over the terrain under it to `destination`, world x
and z (decision 089): `speed` meters a second (0.01 to 100), turning at
most `turn` degrees a second (1 to 10000), its origin `offset` meters
above the ground; around obstacles within `radius` meters (0 to 100),
up steps no steeper than `max_slope` (rise per meter, 0.01 to 10),
through water no deeper than `max_water` meters (0 to 100), over the
pyramid level `level` (0 the finest, up to 15). Changing the
destination searches anew; none stands still. Requires version 9.

NoiseLayer.description:
Procedural ground: fractal gradient noise whose fine octaves fade on
slopes (Quilez's derivative damping), optionally folded into ridges and
warped sideways, shaped toward wide valley floors, then cut by the
erosion filter's gullies running down its slopes.

erosion.description: How deep gullies cut down slopes, 0 (none) to 1.

height.description:
Meters from the lowest to the highest ground before gullies, 0 to
20000.

offset.description: Meters added to every height of the layer, -20000 to 20000.

ridges.description: 0 rolls; 1 folds every octave into sharp ridges.

roughness.description:
How much each finer octave keeps of the coarser one's height, from
0 (smooth slopes up close) through 0.5 (every scale alike) to 1
(rugged).

seed.description: Picks the pattern: the same seed gives the same heights everywhere.

smoothing.description: How much fine detail fades on slopes, 0 to 1.

valleys.description:
0 keeps the heights' spread; 1 widens valley floors and sharpens
peaks.

warp.description:
How far the ground warps sideways, as a share of the wavelength, 0
to 1.

wavelength.description: Meters across the largest features, 16 to 1000000.

NoiseMask.description:
Gradient noise from 0 to 1 with features `wavelength` meters across,
summed over `octaves` (1 to 8), each half as long and half as strong.

PathLayer.description: A road or track along the ground (decision 069).

points.description:
Terrain-local meters along x and z the road runs through, 2 to
4096 of them.

shoulder.description:
Meters on each side over which the road eases back into the
ground, 0 to 500.

smoothing.description:
Meters along the road over which its height averages the ground's,
0 to 5000: longer is gentler, cutting deeper and filling higher.

tunnel_cut.description:
Meters the road would cut into the ground beyond which it tunnels
instead (decision 073), 0 to 2000; 0 never tunnels.

width.description: Meters of level road across, 0.5 to 200.

PlacementChoice.description:
An asset a placement layer chooses, by ID of the surface's assets, and
how often against the layer's others.

PlacementLayer.description:
One layer of objects on a surface: the assets it chooses from; objects
per hectare where everything allows (at most one per footprint
square); the meters between candidates (0.25 to 256); the surface
materials it stands on (IDs; any when empty), weighted by their share;
where its mask allows; its objects' scale range; how far they lean with
the ground (0 upright, 1 along its normal); how far they turn to face
down its slope, their x across it and z down it (0 any way, 1 straight
down it); how deep they sink, in meters at scale 1, below the lowest
ground within their bed, how far around them they rest on (meters at
scale 1, 0 by default: the ground at their point; decision 096), so
blocks on steep slopes stand in them instead of hanging over them; the
pyramid level whose tiles hold its candidates (0, the finest, by
default); and where it also stands far away.

Remap.description: A mask remapped: 0 up to `from`, 1 from `to`, smooth between.

SceneAmbientOcclusion.description: Ambient occlusion (decision 021); an intensity of 0 turns it off.

radius.description: World distance within which geometry occludes.

SceneAnimation.description:
A named animation clip: keyframed channels of the entities `targets`
names. Its channels are inline or in an `EAN1` buffer file (`uri`).

targets.description:
Entity IDs a channel's `target` index names. A player inside a prefab
placement resolves them against the placement's local IDs first.

SceneAtmosphere.description:
Sun, sky, fog and grade (decision 018): a preset and the fields that
differ from it. Colors are linear RGB and may exceed 1.

aerial_start.description:
Aerial perspective (decision 053), version 9: beyond this distance,
air of `aerial_density` per unit at height zero (0: off), thinning by
`aerial_falloff` per unit up, dims toward `aerial_color` and, toward
the sun, an `aerial_glow` of its color.

ambient.description: Scale of the sky's ambient light.

contrast.description:
Contrast around mid grey after tone mapping: 1 keeps it, and the
curve, which keeps black and white, is steepest at 1.5. Version 6
(decision 027), like the grade fields below.

emission.description: Scale of material emission: dim by day, full at night.

fog_density.description: Fog density per world unit at height zero.

fog_falloff.description: How fast fog thins with height, per world unit.

fog_start.description: Fog begins this far from the camera (world units).

rim.description: Silhouette light in the horizon color.

saturation.description: Saturation after tone mapping; 1 keeps it.

shadow_tint.description:
Hue of dark tones after tone mapping (split toning), as a color gain
scaled to keep luminance; white or black keeps them.

specular.description: Scale of sun highlights and sky reflections; 1 is physically based.

sun_direction.description: Direction toward the sun; any nonzero length.

vibrance.description: Saturation added to muted colors more than to vivid ones; 0 adds none.

zenith.description: Sky straight up, at the horizon, and below it.

SceneBloom.description: Bloom (decision 021); an intensity of 0 turns it off.

threshold.description: Exposed brightness above which light glows.

SceneBounds.description: A world box (minimum and maximum corners).

SceneCamera.description: Right-handed, Y-up perspective camera. Lens values are in world units.

SceneChannel.description: One keyframed property of one target.

times.description: Key times in seconds, strictly increasing.

values.description:
Values, three numbers each (four for rotations, as quaternions x, y,
z, w); cubic splines give in-tangent, value and out-tangent per key.

SceneClouds.description:
The cloud layer: whether it draws; how much of the sky it covers (0,
clear, to 1, overcast); the world height of its base and how thick it
is (meters, base -10000 to 30000, thickness 50 to 10000); how dense its
clouds are (0.01 to 4); the wind it drifts in (meters per second along x
and z, each -100 to 100); the meters across its largest shapes (200 to
50000); the seed of its shapes; how much of the sun's light its shadows
take from the ground (0 to 1); the dome's texels around the horizon
(256 to 4096, a multiple of 64; a quarter as many from the horizon up);
the frames over which ordinary frames march the whole dome (1 to 64);
and whether the view marches them a ray per block of `view_block`
pixels along a side (1 to 16) after the opaque scene (decision 095):
then they stand in front of whatever lies beyond them, all around a
camera inside the layer and below one above it, and the sky's dome
shows them behind every surface only while the camera is under the
layer. Opt-in: a scene without a `clouds` section has none. Requires
version 9.

SceneCollider.description:
A collider or sensor on any authored node, including prefab instance roots.
Zero layer masks are valid and intentionally disable matching pairs.

SceneColliderShape.description:
Explicit local collision geometry. Parent transforms apply as full affine
matrices; rendering meshes never supply implicit collider dimensions.

half_extents.description: Positive half sizes on local axes, each in [0.0001, 10000].

radius.description: Local radius in [0.0001, 10000]. Nonuniform transforms form ellipsoids.

SceneContactShadows.description:
Contact shadow settings: whether they trace, how far each ray reaches
toward the sun in meters (0.05 to 4), how much of the sun's light a hit
takes away (0 to 1; 0 turns them off), and the meters from the camera
within which surfaces trace, their shadows fading out over its last
third (decision 098; 1 to 1000). Requires version 9.

SceneDecal.description:
A decal on this entity (decision 039). Requires version 8.

Its box is the entity's local unit cube (`[-0.5, 0.5]` on each axis):
scale the entity to size it. The material's color, base color map,
roughness, metalness and emission span the box's x and z, projected down
its y onto the opaque surfaces inside it that face its +y.

fade_degrees.description:
Degrees between a surface's normal and the box's +y beyond which the
decal fades out, gone at 90.

material.description: ID of the projected material in this document.

SceneDecalBlend.description: How a decal combines with the surface it lies on.

oneOf.description: Covering by alpha, lit like any surface: paint, posters, markings.

Multiplying the surface's color, keeping its light: dirt, cracks,
stains and scorch marks.

max_decals.description:
An optional budget of decals a frame draws; beyond it the decals
nearest the camera win. Omitted, every decal draws.

SceneDeformation.description:
Runtime deformation (decision 083): whether deformers press tracks; the
meters of ground the map around the camera spans (8 to 1024) and its
texels along a side (128 to 8192, a multiple of 128; renderers keep
fewer where the device's buffers cannot hold them); the seconds tracks
take to refill to about a third of their depth (0, never, to 86400);
how high the ground rises beside a track for its depth (0 to 1); an
optional budget of stamps the log keeps, the oldest dropping beyond it;
and whether the log keeps the stamps the map moves away from, so tracks
are there when the camera returns. Requires version 9.

SceneEmitter.description:
A particle emitter on this entity (decision 026). Requires version 6.
Omitted fields take the engine's defaults.

acceleration.description: World acceleration: gravity, buoyancy or wind.

color.description: Linear RGBA at birth and at death, channels in [0, 1]; alpha fades.

direction.description: Direction of emission in the entity's local space; nonzero.

emission.description: Brightness multiple of the color, for glowing particles.

offset.description: Birth position in the entity's local space.

radius.description: Radius of the ball particles start in.

seed.description: Varies random choices between otherwise identical emitters.

size.description: Diameter at birth and at death, in world units.

speed.description: Initial speed in world units per second.

spread_degrees.description:
Half-angle of the cone of initial directions, in degrees; 180 emits
in every direction.

stretch.description: Seconds of travel particles stretch along their motion.

clouds.description: A layer of clouds over the world (decision 084).

contact_shadows.description:
Short rays toward the sun shade what shadow maps cannot hold
(decision 062).

deformation.description: Tracks deformers press into deformable ground (decision 083).

occupancy.description:
What placed objects cover darkens the sky light under them
(decision 059).

sky.description:
A physically based sky, and the time of day moving the sun
(decision 088).

terrain.description:
Version 9: terrain streaming and level of detail (decision 051),
and ground cover (decision 056).

water.description: How terrains' lakes and rivers look (decision 067).

wind.description: The wind ground cover and placed objects sway in (decision 058).

world_streaming.description: How streamed content loads around the camera (decision 086).

SceneFloating.description:
Rides the sea (decision 077): each fixed tick the entity rises and falls
with the sea's surface under it, `draft` meters of it below the surface
(-100 to 100), and leans by `tilt` (0, upright, to 1, with the
surface's normal) about its own heading. Unparented entities only;
nothing moves without an enabled sea. Requires version 9.

density.description:
Scales every cover's density, 0 to 4. Blades sway in the world's
`Wind` (decision 058).

max_blades.description: An optional budget of blades a frame; beyond it the farthest drop.

pixels.description:
How tall on screen (pixels) the average blade stands where tiers
end, 0 to 16: each tier reaches twice as far as the last, with
blades sparser and wider, until its blades would stand shorter than
this. 0 grows cover within the radius alone.

radius.description:
Meters from the camera within which cover grows densest, 2 to 200.
Past it the ground shows as its cover's canopy, and sparser tiers
of wider blades reach on (decision 090).

SceneGrounding.description:
The ground staining the base of an object standing on terrain (decision
096): the linear color its color is multiplied by where it meets the
ground, and how many units of its mesh up the stain fades out, from the
ground's slope under it.

SceneHeightmap.description:
An imported heightmap: a file of little-endian 16-bit samples, row by row
along z (`.r16`), `width` by `height` of them, spanning `size` meters
from terrain-local `min` (x and z). Samples 0 to 65535 map to heights
`low` to `high`; the layer fades in over `falloff` meters inside its
edges and combines by `blend`. `source` and `attribution` (up to 1024
characters each) record where its heights came from and the credit
their data requires, as the `terrain_import` tool writes them (decision
070).

SceneLevelOfDetail.description:
Level of detail settings (decisions 047 and 048): whether instances draw
simplified levels of their meshes, and impostors, where the
simplification stays within a pixel error. Requires version 8.

fade_seconds.description:
Seconds placed objects take to fade between how the camera shows
them, from 0 (at once) to 4 (decision 104).

impostors.description: Whether draw groups draw impostors where they fit (decision 048).

max_impostors.description: The most impostors kept baked; omitted for no budget.

pixel_error.description:
The largest simplification error a drawn level may show, in pixels of
the viewport height, from 0.25 to 64: smaller draws finer levels
farther away.

SceneLight.description:
A point or spot light on this entity (decision 023). Requires version 6.
On an entity with a mesh it follows the mesh's displayed pose.

color.description: Linear color, each channel finite and nonnegative.

intensity.description: Light at one world unit; positive.

offset.description: Position in the entity's local space, scaled with it.

range.description: World distance beyond which the light has no effect; positive.

spot.description: A cone; omitted for light in every direction.

distance.description:
View distance beyond which local light fades out: distant lights
cost no shading.

intensity.description: Scales every light's intensity, e.g. to dim lamps by day.

lights_per_cluster.description:
An optional budget of lights one view cluster lists. Omitted, every
light reaching a cluster shades there.

max_lights.description:
An optional budget of lights a frame shades; beyond it the nearest to
the camera win. Omitted, every light shades.

SceneMap.description:
A material's use of a texture: its ID, or (version 8) a map with glTF
sampler and `KHR_texture_transform` settings.

SceneMaterial.description:
One named material; color channels are linear values in `[0, 1]` and
alpha is 1. `opacity` below 1 (version 6) draws it transparent unless
`alpha_mode` says otherwise. Version 8 adds glTF's texture maps, emissive
color, alpha modes and double-sided surfaces (decision 031); `surface`
roughness and metalness are glTF's roughness and metallic factors.

alpha_cutoff.description: Version 8, `mask` only: alpha below it is not drawn; default 0.5.

alpha_mode.description:
Version 8: how alpha (opacity times base color texture alpha) is
used. Default `blend` below opacity 1, `opaque` otherwise.

double_sided.description: Version 8: draw back faces too, lit from their own side.

emissive.description:
Version 8: emitted linear color, not negative (glTF's emissive factor
times its emissive strength).

grounding.description:
Version 9: the ground staining the base of objects terrains place
(decision 096).

ior.description:
Version 8, with `transmission`: the index of refraction in `[1, 3]`;
default 1.5.

metallic_roughness_texture.description: Version 8: linear green multiplies roughness and blue metalness.

normal_scale.description: Version 8: scales the normal map's deflection; default 1.

normal_texture.description: Version 8: a tangent-space normal map (green up the image).

occlusion_strength.description: Version 8: how much the occlusion map darkens, in `[0, 1]`; default 1.

occlusion_texture.description: Version 8: linear red darkens indirect light.

opacity.description:
The fraction of light behind it the surface covers, in `(0, 1]`
(decision 026). Below 1 it draws transparent, blending in any order,
writing no depth and casting no shadow. Requires version 6. With
`alpha_mode` `mask` it is the alpha the cutoff tests.

surface.description:
How the surface responds to light beyond its color (decision 019).
Requires version 5; without it the material is matte.

texture.description:
Base color texture: its sRGB color multiplies `color`. A texture ID,
or (version 8) a map with sampler and transform settings. IDs clamp at
the texture's edges before version 8 and repeat from version 8.

thickness.description:
Version 8, with `transmission`: the depth in world units of the
volume beneath the surface that bends rays; default 0, a thin wall.

top.description:
Version 9: a layer settling on faces turned up, such as moss,
lichen, dust or snow (decision 093).

transmission.description:
Version 8: the share of light passing through the surface instead of
diffusing off it, in `[0, 1]`, tinted by its color (decision 038,
glTF `KHR_materials_transmission`). Transmissive materials draw in
the transparent pass; the environment's `refraction` bends what shows
through them.

world_tiling.description:
Version 9: lays the maps from the world's axes, one repeat every
this many meters, instead of by texture coordinates (decision 093):
no seams and one texel density at any size, for surfaces that stay
where they are, such as rocks. In `(0, 10000]`.

SceneMesh.description: A named CPU mesh. Sources contain no filesystem paths or executable data.

SceneNavigation.description:
Navigation (decision 089): whether agents walk, and the samples of
search work each fixed tick does at most over every walk being searched
(at least 1024). Requires version 9.

SceneObject.description:
One local transform, optional renderable, or prefab instance root.
Tags are game-defined startup hook names.

animation.description: Plays an animation on its targets (decision 035). Requires version 8.

collider.description: Local collision shape, independent of rendering. Requires version 4.

decal.description:
Projects a material onto the opaque surfaces inside this entity's
box (decision 039). Requires version 8.

deformer.description:
Presses tracks into deformable ground (decision 083). Requires
version 9.

grounded.description:
Stands on the terrain (decision 086): its translation's y becomes
`offset` meters above the ground under it. Roots only. Requires
version 9.

light.description: A point or spot light (decision 023). Requires version 6.

name.description: Optional display label, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.

nav_agent.description:
Walks over the terrain to a destination (decision 089). Roots only.
Requires version 9.

parent.description: Parent ID in the scene, or in this prefab's local definition.

prefab.description: Named prefab to expand below this transform-only instance root.

reflection_probe.description:
Captures this entity's surroundings into an environment map that
surfaces inside its world box reflect (decision 043). Requires
version 8.

skin.description:
The skin deforming this object's mesh (decision 036). Requires
version 8 and a mesh with joints and weights.

spline.description:
One of this document's meshes bent along a curve (decision 071).
Requires version 9.

tags.description: At most 16 distinct authored IDs, each at most 64 ASCII bytes.

terrain.description:
A heightfield terrain whose tiles stream around the camera (decision
051). Requires version 9.

tint.description:
Multiplies this object's color and opacity channel by channel
(decision 033), each factor finite and in `[0, 1]`. Requires version 8.

SceneOccupancy.description:
Occupancy settings: whether the map is drawn, the meters around the
camera within which covers darken, less over the outer two fifths
(decision 098; 64 to 4096), the map's texels a side (128 to 4096), how
much of the sky light full cover takes away (0 to 1), and the meters
the coarser far map reaches (decision 101; 0, none, or the radius to
65536), its texels as many. Requires version 9.

SceneOcean.description:
The sea: whether it draws; the height of the still sea (world meters,
-10000 to 10000); the wind that raised it (meters per second along x and
z), whose speed (0.5 to 30) sets the waves' height and length and whose
direction heads them; how sharply crests stand (0, round swells, to 1,
nearly breaking); the waves it holds (1 to 16); the seed of their
headings and phases; the color deep water scatters back (linear, each 0
to 1); the meters of water through which half the light passes (0.1 to
100); how much foam crests and shores gather (0 to 1); and the meters
from the camera it draws (100 to 100000). Requires version 9.

SceneParticleBlend.description: How particles combine with what is behind them.

oneOf.description: Covering by alpha, lit by the sun and sky: smoke, dust, rain.
Adding light, unlit: sparks, fire.

max_particles.description:
An optional budget of particles a frame draws; beyond it the emitters
nearest the camera win. Omitted, every emitter draws.

ScenePlayer.description: Plays a clip on its targets from this entity (decision 035).

speed.description: Playback rate: 1 is real time, 0 paused, negative backward.

ScenePrefab.description:
A reusable entity tree whose parents reference IDs within the definition.

Instance roots use [`SceneObject::prefab`]. Template roots become children of
that instance root. Nested prefab references are deliberately unsupported.

SceneReflectionProbe.description:
A reflection probe on this entity (decision 043). Requires version 8.

Its box is axis-aligned in world space and centered on the entity's world
position, so the entity's rotation and scale leave it unchanged. Surfaces
inside it reflect what the probe captured from its center (still objects
and still lights), fading out over `blend` toward its faces into the
probes around it or the sky.

blend.description:
World distance inside the box's faces over which the probe fades out;
finite and nonnegative.

extent.description:
Half the box's size along each world axis in world units, each
finite and positive.

interior.description:
Makes the box an interior (decision 079): a cave or a hall letting in
only these shares of the sky's light and the sun's. Requires
version 9.

faces_per_frame.description:
Cube faces captured per frame while probes wait: more fill new places
sooner, fewer keep those frames lighter.

max_probes.description:
An optional budget of probes kept captured; beyond it the probes
nearest the camera win. Omitted, as many as the GPU's texture arrays
hold.

resolution.description:
Texels across each face of every environment map, the sky's
included: a power of two from 16 to 1024.

SceneReflections.description:
Screen-space reflections (decision 025). Requires version 6; an intensity
of 0 turns them off.

max_roughness.description: Surfaces rougher than this reflect only the sky.

SceneRefraction.description:
Refraction through glass (decision 038). Requires version 8; a strength
of 0 turns it off.

blur.description: Blur radius in pixels that fully rough glass reaches.

strength.description: Scales how far rays bend through transmissive materials.

SceneShadows.description: Sun shadows (decision 020); omitted fields take the engine defaults.

bounds.description:
Region to keep shadows for: the whole scene gives the sharpest, stable
shadows. Without it the maps follow the camera.

cascades.description:
Sharper maps (cascades) splitting `near_distance`, each reaching a
third as far as the next: 1 to 4, 3 when omitted. Version 6
(decision 028).

distance.description: Shadows fade out this far from the camera (world units).

level_extent.description:
Side of the finest kept level (world units), which each next level
is four times; 256 when omitted.

levels.description:
Kept levels (decision 065): maps of still casters following the
camera, sharper than the far maps where they reach, each with half
the far maps' `resolution` per side; 0 to 3, none when omitted.
Worlds larger than their shadows' sharpness give them two or three.

near_distance.description: View distance of the sharper maps that follow the camera.

resolution.description: Texels per side of the far maps: 1024, 2048 or 4096.

SceneSkin.description:
A named skin (decision 036): the joint entities that deform skinned meshes
and each joint's inverse bind matrix (column-major, sixteen numbers).

inverse_binds.description: One matrix per joint; identity when omitted.

joints.description: Joint entity IDs, resolved like animation targets.

SceneSky.description:
A physically based sky (decision 088): whether it draws; the planet's
radius and the atmosphere's thickness (kilometers); Rayleigh scattering
per kilometer at the ground (red, green, blue) and the height over which
it thins by e (km); Mie scattering and absorption per kilometer, their
scale height and the forward lobe of their phase (0 to 0.99); ozone
absorption per kilometer at its densest, 25 km up; the ground's albedo;
the sun's intensity (its color's scale above the air) and angular radius
(degrees); how far air hazes what lies away from the camera, as a
multiple of real distance (0 none); the height of the world's origin
above the ground of the planet (meters); and how far exposure adapts to
the sky's light (0 not at all, 1 fully), so that dawn, dusk and night
stay readable. Defaults are Earth's. Opt-in. Requires version 9.

SceneSpline.description:
A mesh bent along a curve on this entity (decision 071). Requires
version 9.

The curve passes through `points` (2 to 4096, in the entity's space),
joined by a centripetal Catmull-Rom spline. Copies of the mesh lie end
to end along it, the mesh's x axis along the curve, its y up and its z
across, each stretched along x so a whole number of them spans it; the
curve's frames keep y up. Chunks of at most 256 meters of curve draw
with the material.

material.description: ID of the material its chunks draw with in this document.

mesh.description: ID of the bent mesh in this document.

SceneSpot.description: The cone of a spot light.

direction.description: Direction the cone points in the entity's local space; nonzero.

inner_angle_degrees.description: Half-angle inside which the light is full, in degrees.

outer_angle_degrees.description:
Half-angle beyond which it is dark, in degrees: at least the inner
angle.

SceneSunShafts.description:
Sun shafts (decision 024): sunlight scattered by the fog between shadow
casters. Requires version 6 and shadows; an intensity of 0 turns them off.

anisotropy.description: Forward scattering: higher concentrates light toward the sun.

distance.description: World distance along each view ray light is gathered over.

SceneSurface.description:
A material's response to light (decision 019). Omitted fields keep the
matte defaults: roughness 0.8 and no metalness, emission or ripples.

emission.description: Emitted light as a multiple of the material color.

metalness.description: Metals reflect in their own color and diffuse no light.

roughness.description: 0 is a mirror, 1 spreads highlights and sky reflections widest.

SceneSurroundings.description:
Ground generated past a terrain's edges to the horizon (decision 094):
a coarser terrain around it from the same layers, its samples four
times as far apart as the terrain's finest, reaching about `reach`
meters past every edge (the terrain's inspection reports how far: its
tiles align with the terrain's sample grids). The terrain's stamps,
heightmaps, bakes and roads fade into its noise over `blend` meters past
its edges (1024 when omitted), so the two meet where it ends. It never
collides, places objects, grows blades or holds water.

SceneTerrain.description:
A heightfield terrain on this entity (decision 051). Requires version 9.

Its first corner (least x and z) lies at `origin` in world space,
whatever the entity's transform; heights rise from the origin's y. Its
heights come from `layers`, applied in order to every sample (later
layers win), or from an `ETR1` `file` beside the scene, whose tiles
stream by byte range. Level-0 tiles span 256 samples `spacing` meters
apart; coarser levels halve the tiles up to one.

collision.description: Whether it collides where collision is installed. Omitted, true.

file.description: An `ETR1` terrain file beside the scene, instead of layers.

layers.description: The layers generating its heights, in order.

spacing.description:
Meters between level-0 samples, 1/64 to 1024. Required with layers;
a file's own when omitted.

surface.description:
Its materials and biomes. Omitted, the engine's default: grass,
bare dirt, rock on steep ground and snow above 650 meters.

surroundings.description:
Ground generated around it to the horizon (decision 094); terrains
read from files have none.

tiles.description:
Level-0 tiles along x and z, 1 to 4096 each. Required with layers;
a file's own when omitted.

SceneTerrainAsset.description:
An object placement layers stand on a terrain (decision 057): a `mesh`
and a `material` of this document, by ID, up to four coarser meshes it
draws at a distance, finest first (otherwise the mesh's automatic levels
of detail), and how far it sways in the wind (decision 058): meters at
ten meters up in full wind, 0 (rigid, the default) to 10.

collider.description:
Its objects' collider (decision 064); without one they never
collide.

SceneTerrainCollider.description:
The collider of a placement asset's objects (decision 064), in its
mesh's space at scale 1: its shape about `center` (the origin by
default), and the collision layers its objects belong to (the first by
default) and collide with (every one by default). Objects within
terrains' collision radius collide; those standing far away never do.

SceneTerrainLayer.description:
One layer of a terrain's stack: procedural noise with erosion, a stamp
(raise, lower, flatten or cut holes), an imported heightmap, an erosion
bake (decision 068) of the layers before it, where rivers wear valleys
and slopes creep, a hydrology bake (decision 066) of them, which
carves channels where water gathers, fills lakes and rivers with water
(decision 067) and feeds the `flow`, `wetness` and `lake` masks, or a
path (decision 069): a road leveling the layers before it along its
line, which feeds the `path` mask (the `terrain_route` request finds
routes for them). Terrains load no tiles until their bakes are done.

SceneTerrainLod.description:
A coarser mesh of a placement asset, by ID, and the largest deviation
from the asset's mesh it shows, in mesh units; errors grow with each.

SceneTerrainMaterial.description:
How one surface material looks: a `material` of this document whose
maps and factors shade it, or a linear `color` and `roughness`; the
meters its textures repeat over (0.01 to 1000); how sharply its height
map wins where it blends with another (0 to 1); whether steep ground
projects it from the side; and the cover growing where it lies
(decision 056).

deform.description: Meters tracks sink it at most (decision 083): 0, rigid, to 2.

relief.description:
Meters its maps' heights span where the ground's relief shows
(decision 082): 0, flat, to 1; top projections only.

SceneTerrainMotionDetail.description:
How terrain loads while the camera moves fast (decision 115): the
finest levels' tiles in its view wait, more of them the faster it
moves, and tiles out of its view wait until it settles. The coarsest
pinned levels, collision's tiles and those under focus entities never
wait, and tiles resident stay.

fastest.description:
Meters per second at which the finest `levels` levels wait, from
`speed` to 100,000; between, fewer wait, at least one.

levels.description: Finest levels whose tiles wait at `fastest`, 0 to 8.

settle.description:
Seconds after the camera slows below `speed` before tiles out of its
view load, 0 to 10.

speed.description: Meters per second above which the camera moves fast, 0 to 100,000.

collision_radius.description:
Meters around the camera and focus entities within which level-0
tiles load for collision, 0 to 4096.

loading_work_ms.description:
Milliseconds a frame works on terrain until the camera's view first
loads whole (decision 099), and after, 0.1 to 1000 each: loading
takes large slices of frames, play small ones.

max_tiles.description:
An optional budget of resident tiles (about 270 KB each, twice that
on the GPU); the least important beyond it drop.

motion_detail.description:
Detail lowered while the camera moves fast (decision 115): off by
default, as it lowers detail in motion on purpose.

pinned_levels.description:
The coarsest levels kept resident over the whole terrain, so it
always draws whole, from 1 to 8.

pixel_error.description:
Pixels a level's samples span before the next coarser level takes
over, 1 to 64; smaller draws more triangles.

relief_distance.description:
Meters from the camera within which the ground's relief (decision
082) shows, its view rays marching through its materials' heights,
0 (none) to 200; and the most steps a ray takes, 2 to 64.

samples_per_frame.description:
Work generated, decoded or baked between checks of the frame's work
time, in samples' worth (67,000 a decoded tile, about 500,000 a
generated one); a frame's whole work where hosts give terrain no
clock.

shadow_resolution.description: Texels along a horizon map's sides, 64 to 4096 (8 bytes each).

shadow_softness.description:
Shadow edge height per meter to the slope casting it (the sun's disc
gives 0.0093).

sky_resolution.description: Texels along a sky visibility map's sides, 64 to 4096 (4 bytes each).

sky_visibility.description:
Ambient light on terrain scaled by how much sky its ground sees
(decision 055): each terrain's sky visibility map, built once its
finest pinned level is resident, where valleys and hollows see less
sky and take their own light back instead.

sun_shadows.description:
Long sun shadows through each terrain's horizon map (decision 052),
with shadows on; shadow maps then draw terrain near the camera only.
Off, terrain casts into the shadow maps alone.

surroundings.description:
Ground generated around terrains with surroundings (decision 094)
streams and draws; off, every terrain ends at its edges.

SceneTerrainSurface.description:
A terrain's surface (decision 054): up to 255 materials, which biome
layers name by ID, and up to 255 biomes. Later biomes paint over earlier
ones where they fit; the first covers wherever none of the others do.

assets.description: What placement layers stand on the terrain (decision 057).

bridge.description:
ID of the document material its roads' bridges (decision 072) draw
with; omitted, a weathered stone.

placed.description: Objects authors stand on it (decision 085), each at its own point.

SceneTexture.description:
Opaque RGBA8 sRGB pixels in row-major, top-to-bottom order: inline as
base64, or (version 7, decision 030) an image file beside the scene that
the host decodes with the platform's own decoder when the scene loads.

Decoding never happens in simulation or rendering. Scenes store one level;
the renderer generates mip levels and samples them trilinearly.

rgba8.description:
Inline pixels: canonical padded RFC 4648 base64; each alpha byte must
equal 255.

uri.description:
An image file (PNG, JPEG or WebP) as a path relative to the scene,
instead of inline pixels. Version 7.

SceneTextureMap.description:
A texture map with its sampling and placement. Omitted settings take
glTF's defaults: repeating, trilinear, untransformed.

mipmap_filter.description:
Filtering between mip levels; `none` samples the full-size texture
only.

offset.description:
Texture coordinates are scaled, rotated by `rotation` radians, then
offset.

tex_coord.description:
The texture coordinates the map reads: 0, the mesh's first (the
default), or 1, its second (decision 034).

SceneTimeOfDay.description:
The time of day (decision 088): whether it moves the sun; the hour (0 to
24); how many hours pass each second (0 holds it, up to 24); the
minutes of each step the sun moves by (0.1 to 60); the latitude and day
of the year (0 to 365) that set the sun's path; and the yaw of north in
the world (degrees from -z toward +x). Opt-in. Requires version 9.

SceneTopLayer.description:
A layer settling on a material's faces turned up (decision 093): its
linear color, how far from straight up it reaches (0 covers nothing, 1
every face turned up at all) and its roughness (default 0.85).

SceneTransform.description:
Local transform with Euler XYZ rotation expressed in degrees.

Translation is bounded to ±1,000,000 world units and each scale component
to `[0.0001, 10000]`, avoiding singular or overflowing normal transforms.
Parent composition preserves full matrices, including shear. Negative scale
reflection is not authored by this format.

SceneVertex.description: CPU vertex authoring data; the renderer owns its separate upload layout.

color.description:
Version 8: linear RGBA in `[0, 1]` multiplying the material's base
color (decision 034). Every vertex of a mesh has one or none does.

joints.description:
Version 8: up to four joints (indices into the skin of the entities
drawing the mesh) moving this vertex (decision 036). Every vertex of
a mesh has joints and weights or none does.

uv1.description:
Version 8: second texture coordinates, which texture maps may read.
Every vertex of a mesh has them or none does.

weights.description:
Version 8: the joints' weights, not negative and not all zero; they
are normalized.

SceneVirtualGeometry.description:
Virtual geometry settings (decision 044): whether meshes built as cluster
hierarchies draw the clusters each view needs, and how coarse those may
be. Requires version 8.

pixel_error.description:
The largest simplification error a drawn cluster may show, in pixels
of the viewport height, from 0.25 to 64: smaller draws more
triangles.

visibility_buffer.description:
Whether the camera's clusters shade through the visibility buffer
(decision 045), each pixel once; false shades them as they draw,
which was faster on the integrated GPU measured. Omitted, false.

SceneWater.description:
Water settings: whether water draws; the color deep water scatters back
(linear, each 0 to 1); the meters of water through which half the light
passes (0.1 to 100); how strongly ripples tilt its surface (0 to 1); the
meters across its largest ripples (0.1 to 100); how much foam shores and
rapids gather (decision 074; 0, none, to 1); and the meters of water
shallower than which shores foam (0.05 to 10). Requires version 9.

SceneWind.description:
The wind: its horizontal velocity (x and z, meters per second, each -40
to 40) and how strongly gusts traveling with it vary its push, 0 to 1.
Requires version 9.

SceneWorldStreaming.description:
World streaming (decision 086): whether streamed items load at all
(off unloads every cell); how far cells load, as a multiple of each
grid's range (0.05 to 20); how much farther than that every source must
be before a loaded cell unloads, as a multiple (1 to 4); the seconds
ahead along the camera's motion cells load early for (0 to 10); the
entities a frame spawns at most (cells spawn whole, and at least one a
frame), pacing loads; and whether cells stay as they are, loading and
unloading nothing (for captures and inspection). Requires version 9.

Stamp.description:
A local edit: full strength within `radius` meters of `center`, fading
out over `falloff` meters beyond.

center.description: Terrain-local meters along x and z.

StampOp.description:
What a stamp does where it reaches: raise or lower heights by meters,
level them toward a height, or cut holes in the terrain.

oneOf.description:
Cells whose centers lie within the radius are holes: no surface
draws or collides there.

SurfaceProjection.description:
How a surface material's textures lie on the ground: from above, or
on steep ground also from the side, so cliffs don't stretch them.
